titre: Electricity metering check on a logistics site
imageAlt: Grid of electricity meters linked to the EcoStruxure EBO supervisor
resume: Checking data from 55 electricity meters, from M221 PLCs up to EcoStruxure Building Operation, on a logistics site near Roissy airport.
contexte: On a logistics site near Roissy, electricity metering data must reach the BMS reliably to monitor consumption.
realisations: Checking data from 55 meters, from the M221 PLCs up to EBO
Identifying and tracking discrepancies and installation punch-list items
Writing the metering technical report
resultat: 55 electricity meters checked end to end

imageAlt: Diagram of a building connected to a BMS, an AI and a cybersecurity shield
resume: ESIEE-IT Project Lab: leading a team of 5 (BMS, AI, cybersecurity) up to the scoping review.
contexte: Team project of the ESIEE-IT Project Lab: designing a smart building that optimises its operation with a BMS and AI, without monitoring its occupants.
realisations: Leading a multidisciplinary team of 5 (BMS, AI, cybersecurity)
Scoping the need, the perimeter and the deliverables
Preparing and presenting the scoping review

imageAlt: Mobile app showing power, voltage, current and energy of a smart plug
resume: Mobile app controlling a smart plug and displaying W, V, A and kWh, through a Raspberry Pi, Domoticz and Mosquitto.
contexte: Making an appliance's electricity consumption visible and controlling it remotely from a smartphone.
realisations: Setting up a home-automation gateway on a Raspberry Pi with Domoticz
Exchanging measurements and commands over MQTT through the Mosquitto broker
Flutter mobile app: on / off control of the Z-Wave smart plug
Real-time display of power (W), voltage (V), current (A) and energy (kWh)
resultat: 4 electrical values displayed in real time: W, V, A and kWh

titre: BMS prospecting and the BACS decree
imageAlt: Map of the Val-d'Oise with targeted buildings and sent emails
resume: Email campaign helping buildings in the Val-d'Oise, then the Île-de-France region, get ahead of the BACS decree.
contexte: The French BACS decree requires a BMS in many commercial buildings: owners benefit from equipping before the deadline.
realisations: Finding prospects in the Val-d'Oise
Preparing an email campaign
Highlighting the obligations of the BACS decree
resultat: Val-d'Oise targeted first, then extended to Île-de-France

imageAlt: Fridge with a recognition camera and a list of expiry dates
resume: Product recognition by computer vision and expiry-date tracking to reduce food waste.
contexte: Food waste often starts in the fridge: forgotten products go past their expiry date.
realisations: Study of a connected fridge that recognises products by vision
Expiry-date tracking and alerts before expiry
Writing a thesis and giving an oral presentation in English
resultat: Thesis written and presented in English

imageAlt: Browser window connected to an API, with a 3D building
resume: React site + Express API without a database: JSON content, search, dark mode, bilingual, 3D BMS demo and scroll animations.

React front end with routing, search combined with filters and a remembered light / dark mode

Scroll animations, animated counters and 3D tilting cards

imageAlt: Electric vehicle charging station next to a construction schedule
resume: Construction-phase schedule for installing an electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

Sequencing and timing the tasks in a schedule
Overall view to coordinate the contractors

imageAlt: Entity-relationship diagram linking players, clubs, matches and training
resume: Conceptual data model (MCD) and data dictionary to manage players, clubs, competitions, matches and training.
contexte: A table-tennis club needs to track its players, rankings, matches and training in a consistent database.
realisations: Writing the data dictionary
Modelling the entities: players, clubs, categories, rankings, competitions, venues, results, matches, opponents, match analyses, coaches, training camps and training content
Defining the relationships and cardinalities between entities

imageAlt: JavaScript code editor next to a histogram of grades

Computing averages and assigning honours
Statistics per student group
Organising the code into modules (etudiants.js, analyse.js)

imageAlt: Hangman gallows with a partially guessed word and a scoreboard

Words drawn from an external file
